dedupe_keys.name: covered conductor antenna fault signals for 22 kv lines

description: VSB Technical University of Ostrava publishes antenna measurements for identifying faults in XLPE-covered conductors on 22-kV distribution lines. The collection covers twelve fault categories, including phase-to-ground and inter-phase faults and no-fault conditions with steel or covered conductors. Three antennas provide measurements containing one million floating-point observations per sample. A public Figshare archive is free under CC BY 4.0. These signals can calibrate fault-detection components and condition classifications used in distribution-network simulations with platform-opendss. A caveat is that laboratory categories do not establish field failure rates or detection performance under every interference condition. Acquisition geometry and signal conversion must remain attached to each comparison. The repository was published in 2024; exact measurement dates and binary contents were not independently checked.
